entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I bought a few weeks ago. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 28 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what my wife expected for her gift. We just want to return it and get something else.

I understand completely. Let me just check our policy... Yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened and the helmet is unused, that's no problem at all. We take safety very seriously, so we're happy to process a return on an unused item. I can approve that for you right now.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate how easy that was. Since I'm going to be placing a new order for a different helmet, and I had to take the time to call in for this return, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable question. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for standard preference-based returns. However, I can assure you'll receive a full refund for the original purchase price as soon as we receive the item back at our warehouse.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is fine. What's the next step?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
